document.heading: The Second Amendment to the Grant Application and Authorization Act of 2017 to

recital.text: the Kiowa Tribe is a sovereign nation and has been so since time immemorial; and,
the Tribe exercises full enjoyment of the inherent powers of government, including self-determination and autonomy over internal affairs encompassing Tribe citizens, lands, and resources; and,
on April 17, 2017, qualified voters of the Tribe ratified the Kiowa Constitution as "the supreme law of the land"; and,

the Legislature of the Tribe is vested with the authority to pass laws and resolutions authorizing the Chairman of the Tribe to negotiate and enter into agreements and contracts on behalf of the Tribe pursuant to Article V, Section 6(a) of the Constitution; and,
the Legislature has identified the need for clarification in statute to the protocols governing pursuit of grant monies; and,

the Legislature has previously authorized and directed the Chairman to negotiate and execute Self-determination Act contracts, called "638-contracts", pursuant to the Indian Self-Determination and Education Act of 1975, as amended, PL 93-638 ("ISDEAA"), with the federal government to assume and takeover the functions previously provided by federal agencies including the Indian Health Service ("IHS"); and,

the ISDEAA also provides for Self-Governance agreements or compacts with the Tribe to aggregate 638-contracts, assume new federal functions and duties, re-design the programs, authorize funding transfers, and authorize funding carry-over, and the Tribe's decision to aggregate current and/or future 638-contracts and turning them into one Self-Governance agreement represents a continuation of the Tribe's self-determination to provide the Tribe with maximum control of federally-funded programs and services, and an exercise of the Tribe's sovereignty; and,

the Tribe currently contracts with the Indian Health Service ("IHS") to administer certain functions and programs, and desires to also operate such programs and any other new programs under a Title V Self-Governance agreement; and,

the Tribe currently has an ownership interest in property and buildings that may be utilized for health care purposes related to the Self-Governance agreement, and/or the Tribe intends to lease suitable property for such proposes; and,

the Tribe is prepared to submit, or has already submitted, three years of the Tribe's financial audits that contain no material audit exceptions as part of its application for a Self-Governance agreement with the IHS, which demonstrates the Tribe's financial capability.

that the Legislature hereby passes the attached law entitled, "The Second Amendment to the Self-Determination 638-Contract Authorization Act of 2017 to Authorize Contracting with the Federal Government for an IHS Self-Governance Compact and Associated Funding", authorizing and directing the Chairman to negotiate and execute a Self-Governance Compact with the IHS on behalf of the Tribe, subject to ratification by the Legislature.

that the Legislature hereby authorizes the Chairman and his authorized designees to negotiate and execute 105(l) leases on tribally owned or leased buildings used to support the federal programs covered under a Self-Governance compact.

that the Legislature hereby authorizes the Chairman and his authorized designees to coordinate with the IHS Office of Self Governance, and all other appropriate agencies and organizations for the compilation of all information necessary to negotiate and execute a Self-Governance Agreement, including the authority to execute any and all required documents and take such further action as may be necessary to implement this Resolution and law.

section.heading: Short Title
section.text: This enactment shall be known as, "The Second Amendment to the Self-Determination 638-Contact Authorization Act of 2017 To Authorize Contracting with the Federal Government for an IHS Self-Governance Compact and Associated Funding" or the "IHS Self-Governance Compact Act" ("Act").

section.heading: Purpose
section.text: The purpose of this Act is to authorize and direct the Chairman to negotiate and execute a Self-Governance Compact with the Indian Health Service ("IHS") as authorized under the Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act of 1975, as amended.

section.heading: Findings
section.text: The Legislature hereby finds and declares that:

para.text: The Kiowa Tribe is a federally recognized Indian Tribe ("Tribe") with a constitution approved by the Secretary of the Interior ("Constitution"); and,

The Legislature of the Tribe is vested with the authority to pass laws and resolutions authorizing the Chairman of the Tribe to negotiate and enter into agreements and contracts on behalf of the Tribe pursuant to Article V, Section 6(a) of the Constitution; and,
The Legislature has identified the need for clarification in statute to the protocols governing pursuit of grant monies; and,

The Legislature has previously authorized and directed the Chairman to negotiate and execute Self-determination Act contracts, called "638-contracts", pursuant to the Indian Self-Determination and Education Act of 1975, as amended, PL 93-638 ("ISDEAA"), with the federal government to assume and takeover the functions previously provided by federal agencies including the Indian Health Service ("IHS"); and,

The ISDEAA also provides for Self-Governance agreements or compacts with the Tribe to aggregate 638-contracts, assume new federal functions and duties, re-design the programs, authorize funding transfers, and authorize funding carry-over, and the Tribe's decision to aggregate current and/or future 638-contracts and turning them into one Self-Governance agreement represents a continuation of the Tribe's self-determination to provide the Tribe with maximum control of federally-funded programs and services, and an exercise of the Tribe's sovereignty; and,

The Tribe currently contracts with the Indian Health Service ("IHS") to administer certain functions and programs, and desires to also operate such programs and any other new programs under a Title V Self-Governance agreement; and,

The Tribe currently has an ownership interest in property and buildings that may be utilized for health care purposes related to the Self-Governance agreement, and/or the Tribe intends to purchase or lease additional suitable property or properties for such proposes; and,

The Tribe is prepared to submit, or has already submitted, three years of the Tribe's financial audits that contain no material audit exceptions as part of its application for a Self-Governance agreement with the IHS, which demonstrates the Tribe's financial capability.

section.heading: Authorization to Negotiate and Execute a Self-Governance Agreement with the IHS

para.text: The Legislature hereby passes the attached law entitled, "The Second Amendment to the Self-Determination Authorization Act of 2017 to Authorize Contracting with the Federal Government for an IHS Self-Governance Compact and Associated Funding", authorizing and directing the Chairman to negotiate and execute a Self-Governance Compact with the IHS on behalf of the Tribe, subject to ratification by the Legislature.

The Legislature hereby authorizes the Chairman and his authorized designees to negotiate and execute 105(l) leases on tribally owned or leased buildings used to support the federal programs covered under a Self-Governance compact, including the authorization to purchase or lease additional property or properties for such purposes.

The Legislature hereby authorizes the Chairman and his authorized designees to coordinate with the IHS Office of Self Governance, and all other appropriate agencies and organizations for the compilation of all information necessary to negotiate and execute a Self-Governance Agreement, including the authority to execute any and all required documents and take such further action as may be necessary to implement this Resolution and law.
